body:
origin/codex/optimize-texture-loading-with-shaders (cached shader VBO for static terrain, replacing thousands of immediate-mode texture submissions/frame) had gone unmerged since 2026-01. Conflicts were mostly additive new GL uniform wrappers (gl_uniform1i alongside HEAD's own gl_uniform3fv/gl_uniform1f). Found and fixed a real bug introduced by the merge itself: the resolved terrain-shader block referenced g_ground_tex before its own declaration (C forward-reference error) -- relocated the whole terrain_shader_init/draw_terrain_shader block to after g_ground_tex's declaration. make -B all and go test ./... both clean. Commit b6b7f4f.

⚓ ☃
title: Merged abandoned texture-loading-through-shaders branch, fixed a declaration-order bug from the merge
